about: Phase 38 reasoning-cache item set. Each seed is solved by System 2 and built into an entry; the variants test the cache. 'oracle' is a Python expression over the values 'v' that gives the right answer independently of the cache. Kinds: phrasal (other words, same numbers), parametric (same words, other numbers), combined (both), near_miss (same topic and numbers, a different question that needs other reasoning; the cache must miss or still be right).
